أقترن (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِنُ (ʔaqtarinu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# أَقْتَرِنَ (ʔaqtarina) /ʔaq.ta.ri.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
# أَقْتَرِنْ (ʔaqtarin) /ʔaq.ta.rin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِقْتَرَنَ (iqtarana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
